metadata.description: Iterative refinement of revenue by segment analysis with corrections

turns.content: Show me revenue by customer segment for 2024.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue breakdown by segment

turns.content: For revenue calculations, only include invoices with status 'paid'.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter invoices to paid status

turns.content: When I say segment, I mean account industry. Use accounts.industry for segmentation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use industry column for segmentation

turns.content: Exclude 'Internal' accounts from all analyses — those are test accounts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out Internal accounts

turns.content: Apply the same filters we've established to show me top accounts by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: paid invoices, use industry, exclude Internal

turns.content: Just to confirm — what filters are we currently applying?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: For invoice dates, always use invoice.billing_date.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use billing_date

turns.content: Remember the paid invoice filter we established? Apply that to show collection rate by segment.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the paid invoice filter we established
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use paid status filter

turns.content: Earlier we excluded Internal accounts. What revenue did they generate?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show Internal account revenue

turns.content: Keep Internal excluded. Show me the final revenue summary.
Apply all the corrections we've made to show me a final dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply all established corrections

turns.content: What was the revenue for Technology segment?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Technology segment revenue

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that Technology and Finance are our highest revenue segments, with Enterprise tier driving most revenue across all segments.

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude Internal accounts from all analyses

anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Paid invoices, use industry, exclude Internal

anaphoricReferences.phrase: the paid invoice filter we established
